author: Ari Koslow
title: Stephen Kolek to make rehab start Saturday
desc: The Royals say Stephen Kolek will make a rehab start on Saturday.
impact: Kolek has been away with his family since his last start. He should make a start early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominic Fletcher re-signs with Pirates on minor league deal
desc: The Pirates re-signed OF Dominic Fletcher to a minor league contract.
impact: Fletcher returns to the Pirates organization after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Freddy Fermin activated from IL
desc: The Padres activated C Freddy Fermin from the 10-day injured list.
impact: Fermin returns from a head injury that sidelined him in early July. Rodolfo Duran was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rodolfo Duran optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Padres optioned C Rodolfo Durán to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Duran returns to Triple-A with Freddy Fermin activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keegan Akin undergoes Tommy John surgery
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz told reporters that Keegan Akin underwent Tommy John surgery.
impact: "It's a big loss for us," Albernaz said. Akin will likely miss the start of next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Bassitt (back) throws long toss Friday
desc: Chris Bassitt threw long toss on Friday.
impact: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Bassitt is in a "good spot" and is "very eager" to progress his rehab. He is only about three weeks post-op from minor back surgery to remove a bone spur.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blaze Alexander (hand) without timetable to return
desc: The Orioles say Blaze Alexander does not hold a timetable to return.
impact: Alexander's left hand is in a splint. Once the bone heals, he'll begin physical activity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: William Kempner (elbow) still shut down from throwing
desc: William Kempner remains shut down from throwing.
impact: Kempner was placed on the injured list earlier this week due to a right elbow sprain. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronny Henriquez (elbow) throwing from 60 feet
desc: Ronny Henriquez has ramped up to throwing from 60 feet.
impact: Henriquez has been on the 60-day injured list all season. He'll likely progress to returning to the mound soon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Ekness (calf) continuing on progression
desc: Josh Ekness is in the late stages of his progression.
impact: Ekness was transferred to the 60-day injured list back in June. He is likely on track to return in August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Nardi (rib) progressing on throwing program
desc: Andrew Nardi is continuing to progress on his throwing program.
impact: Nardi has been on the injured list since May. He is targeting his return in August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Owen Caissie (calf) resumes baseball activities
desc: Owen Caissie has resumed baseball activities.
impact: Caissie was placed on the injured list last week. He is expected to miss 1-3 more weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John King (ankle) working on pitch design
desc: John King is working on his pitch design and running.
impact: King was placed on the 15-day injured list with a left lateral ankle sprain last week. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Bender (shin) resumes throwing
impact: Bender has resumed light baseball activities. He has been on the injured list since late June with a right shin stress reaction.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Palencia (elbow) hopeful to return mid-August
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Daniel Palencia is hopeful to return by the middle of August.
impact: Palencia is continuing to slowly work his way back. He'll figure to be sent on a rehab assignment later in July or early August.
